title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps use blue and green curves that some colour-blind users cannot tell apart (for example deflection and stress in Session 2).

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette or line styles that stay distinguishable in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Both curves distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: moving-load envelope
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's second milestone does not exist yet; the shipped code handles one fixed load.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Bridge beams must be checked for the worst position of a moving load group.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add an interior support to the finite-element solver
body:
## Problem
`solve_beam` has only simple and cantilever end supports, so continuous beams cannot be solved.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 3. The middle reaction of two equal spans under a uniform load is 1.25 q L.

## Expected outcome
An option for supports at any node, with a test against the 1.25 q L result.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-03/checkpoint.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Middle reaction within 1% of 1.25 q L
- [ ] Existing checkpoints still pass

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Reproduce the Target: a depth-versus-weight explorer
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a moving load with linked shear, moment and deflection diagrams and a depth-versus-weight chart; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Lightest passing depth within 5 mm of an exhaustive search for spans from 4 m to 10 m
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
